name: Commerce BOXNOW
description: integrates the BOX NOW parcel-locker API as a Commerce shipping method.
project_description:
The BoxNow Shipping module extends the functionality of the Drupal Commerce module by integrating shipping methods with BoxNow, a smart parcel delivery solution. This module enables merchants to offer locker-based delivery services, ensuring fast, secure, and convenient parcel deliveries.

 Features 
 Basic Functionality 
 The module adds a new shipping method to the Drupal Commerce system, allowing orders to be delivered to BoxNow lockers. This solution offers businesses an efficient last-mile delivery option.

 Unique Features 
 
 Seamless integration with BoxNow's delivery API. 
 Option for customers to select a locker location during checkout. 
 Real-time updates and communication with BoxNow for shipping statuses. 
 
 Use Cases 
 
 For e-commerce websites needing reliable and secure parcel delivery. 
 Businesses looking to enhance their shipping options with locker-based delivery solutions. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once the module is installed, follow these steps:

 
 Navigate to Commerce → Configuration → Shipping Methods. 
 Add a new shipping method and select BoxNow Shipping as the type. 
 Enter the credentials provided by BoxNow to authenticate the integration. 
 Configure the shipping method settings, such as pricing, region restrictions, or service availability. 
 
 No additional content types or text formats are required.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal Commerce Shipping module: This module is required as a dependency for managing shipping methods. 
 Valid API credentials from BoxNow for proper communication with their systems. 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Are there any projects that enhance or improve the functionality of this project?

 
 Address module: Enhances user input for shipping addresses. 
 Commerce Checkout: Streamlines the checkout process, including the selection of shipping methods. 
 Commerce Shipping Extras: Adds advanced features for managing multiple shipping options. 
 
 This module is not in any way associated with the BOX NOW company itself. Back to top
